description_en: Retrieves the attributes of an endpoint
description_zh: 获取终端节点属性信息
name: GetVpcEndpointAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the endpoint whose attributes you want to retrieve.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
获取属性信息的终端节点所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint whose attributes you want to retrieve
parameters.help_zh: 获取属性信息的终端节点ID
parameters.name: endpoint_id

AddressIpVersion.description_en:
The IP version. Valid values:

IPv4: IPv4.

DualStack: Dual-stack
AddressIpVersion.description_zh:
协议版本。取值：

IPv4：IPv4类型。
DualStack：双栈类型

Bandwidth.description_en: The connection bandwidth of the endpoint. Unit: Mbit/s
Bandwidth.description_zh: 终端节点的连接带宽。单位：Mbps

ConnectionStatus.description_en:
The endpoint connection status. Valid values:

Pending: The endpoint is being modified.

Connecting: The endpoint is being connected.

Connected: The endpoint is connected.

Disconnecting: The endpoint is being disconnected.

Disconnected: The endpoint is disconnected.

Deleting: The endpoint is being deleted.

ServiceDeleted: The associated endpoint service is deleted
ConnectionStatus.description_zh:
终端节点连接状态。取值：

Pending：修改中。

Connecting：连接中。

Connected：已连接。

Disconnecting：断开连接中。

Disconnected：未连接。

Deleting：删除中。

ServiceDeleted：对应的终端节点服务已删除

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the endpoint was created. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
CreateTime.description_zh: 终端节点的创建时间。采用ISO 8601标准的UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

CrossRegionBandwidth.description_en: The cross-region bandwidth of the endpoint. Unit: Mbit/s
CrossRegionBandwidth.description_zh: 终端节点的跨地域带宽值。单位：Mbps

EndpointBusinessStatus.description_en:
The business status of the endpoint. Valid values:

Normal: Normal.

FinancialLocked: Locked due to overdue payments
EndpointBusinessStatus.description_zh:
终端节点的业务状态。取值：

Normal：正常。

FinancialLocked：欠费锁定

EndpointDomain.description_en: The domain name of the endpoint

EndpointStatus.description_en:
The status of the endpoint. Valid values:

Creating: The endpoint is being created.

Active: The endpoint is active.

Pending: The endpoint is being modified.

Deleting: The endpoint is being deleted
EndpointStatus.description_zh:
终端节点状态。取值：

Creating：创建中。

Active：可用。

Pending：修改中。

Deleting：删除中

EndpointType.description_en:
The endpoint type. Valid values:

Interface: Interface endpoint.

Reverse: Reverse endpoint.

GatewayLoadBalancer: Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) endpoint
EndpointType.description_zh:
终端节点类型。取值：

Interface：表示接口终端节点。

Reverse：表示反向终端节点。
GatewayLoadBalancer： 表示网关型负载均衡终端节点

Payer.description_en:
The payer. Valid values:

Endpoint: The service consumer.

EndpointService: The service provider
Payer.description_zh:
付费方。取值：

Endpoint：服务使用方。

EndpointService：服务提供方

PolicyDocument.description_en: The RAM access policy. For more information about policy definitions, see [Policy elements]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93738.html）
PolicyDocument.description_zh: RAM权限策略。关于策略定义的更多信息，请参见[权限策略基本元素]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93738.html）

ProtectedEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether managed protection is enabled for STS calls. Valid values:

true: Enabled. After managed protection is enabled, only the user who created the endpoint can modify or delete the endpoint by using STS.

false: Disabled
ProtectedEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启托管保护，STS 调用方式下生效。取值：

true：开启。开启托管保护后，只有和创建时相同的用户才能通过 STS 方式对该终端节点进行修改或者删除等操作。

false：不开启
ProtectedEnabled.title_en:
是否开启托管保护，STS 调用方式下生效。取值：

true：开启。开启托管保护后，只有和创建时相同的用户才能通过 STS 方式对该终端节点进行修改或者删除等操作。

false：不开启。
ProtectedEnabled.title_zh:
是否开启托管保护，STS 调用方式下生效。取值：

true：开启。开启托管保护后，只有和创建时相同的用户才能通过 STS 方式对该终端节点进行修改或者删除等操作。

false：不开启。

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the endpoint

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

ResourceOwner.description_en:
Indicates whether the endpoint and the endpoint service belong to the same account. Valid values:

true: Yes.

false: No
ResourceOwner.description_zh:
终端节点和终端节点服务是否同一账号。取值：

true：是。

false：否

ServiceId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint service associated with the endpoint
ServiceId.description_zh: 终端节点关联的终端节点服务的ID

ServiceName.description_en: The name of the endpoint service associated with the endpoint
ServiceName.description_zh: 终端节点关联的终端节点服务的名称

ServiceRegionId.description_en: The region ID of the endpoint service associated with the endpoint
ServiceRegionId.description_zh: 终端节点关联的终端节点服务所属的地域 ID

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the endpoint belongs
VpcId.description_zh: 终端节点所属的专有网络ID

ZoneAffinityEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether nearest resolution is supported for the domain name of the endpoint service. Valid values:

true: Yes.

false: No
ZoneAffinityEnabled.description_zh:
是否支持连接服务的终端节点域名就近解析。取值：

true：是。

false：否

ZonePrivateIpAddressCount.description_en: The number of private IP addresses of the elastic network interface (ENI) in each zone. Valid value: 1
ZonePrivateIpAddressCount.description_zh: 每个可用区ENI的私网IP的数量。仅取值：1
